reasons: Detention billed for full 6.5 hours instead of 4.5 chargeable hours per Clause 5.2
Invoice total is $120 above the contract-supported amount
decision.dispute_summary: Detention charge exceeds free time. Contract allows 2 free hours; 6.5 hrs billed at $60/hr results in $390, but only 4.5 hrs (6.5‑2) are payable, amounting to $270. Overcharge of $120.
